# Employee Module - Test Case Document
**Project:** Religious Affairs Management System (RAMS)
**Module:** Employee | **Version:** 1.0.0 | **Date:** 2026-08-05
**Author:** QA Team / RAMS Architect
**Format:** Manual + Automated (PHPUnit Feature Tests)
## Legend
| Symbol | Meaning |
| P1 | Priority 1 - Must pass before any release |
| P2 | Priority 2 - Must pass before sprint close |
| P3 | Priority 3 - Edge case coverage |
| Critical | System crash, data loss, security breach |
| High | Major feature broken, wrong data |
| Medium | Minor feature broken, workaround exists |
| Low | Cosmetic, UX issue |
## Section 1 - Authentication Guard
> All employee routes are inside the auth + company.active + user.active middleware group. Unauthenticated visitors must be redirected to /login for every route.
| TC-ID | Title | Priority | Severity | Preconditions | Steps | Expected Result |
| TC-EMP-001 | Guest GET /employees redirects to login | P1 | Critical | User is not logged in | GET /employees | HTTP 302 to /login |
| TC-EMP-002 | Guest GET /employees/create redirects to login | P1 | Critical | User is not logged in | GET /employees/create | HTTP 302 to /login |
| TC-EMP-003 | Guest POST /employees redirects to login | P1 | Critical | User is not logged in | POST /employees with valid payload | HTTP 302 to /login |
| TC-EMP-004 | Guest GET /employees/{id} redirects to login | P1 | Critical | User is not logged in | GET /employees/1 | HTTP 302 to /login |
| TC-EMP-005 | Guest GET /employees/{id}/edit redirects to login | P1 | Critical | User is not logged in | GET /employees/1/edit | HTTP 302 to /login |
| TC-EMP-006 | Guest PATCH /employees/{id} redirects to login | P1 | Critical | User is not logged in | PATCH /employees/1 | HTTP 302 to /login |
| TC-EMP-007 | Guest DELETE /employees/{id} redirects to login | P1 | Critical | User is not logged in | DELETE /employees/1 | HTTP 302 to /login |
